import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=16, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.identity = nn.Identity()
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features='mask', out_features=128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=128, out_features=10)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        x = self.conv1(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 16, 32, 32)
        x = self.relu(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 16, 32, 32)
        x = self.conv2(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 32, 32)
        x = self.relu(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 32, 32)
        x = self.maxpool(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 16, 16)
        x = self.identity(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 16, 16)
        x = self.flatten(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 8192)
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.relu(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 3, 32, 32)
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
